card.line: Cush is a land south of Egypt. The Bible speaks of its king, its people, and its hope, and says Cush will one day reach out to God.

moments.title: Tirhakah, King of Cush
moments.text: Sennacherib is warned that Tirhakah, king of Cush, has set out to fight him. Sennacherib sends messengers to Hezekiah again, and Hezekiah spreads the letter out before the LORD.

moments.title: Cush Reaches Out to God
moments.text: The psalm says messengers will come from Egypt, and Cush will stretch out her hands to God. The kingdoms of the earth are told to sing praises to Him.

moments.title: A Warning About Cush
moments.text: The LORD has Isaiah go naked and barefoot for three years as a sign against Egypt and Cush. The king of Assyria will lead away captives of Cush, and those who made Cush their hope will be ashamed.

moments.title: Offerings from Beyond Cush
moments.text: The LORD says His worshipers, His scattered people from beyond the rivers of Cush, will bring Him an offering. He also says He will leave a humble people who trust in His name.
